name: Spire View: The Executive Conversation
creator: Axiom Broadcast Syndicate, hosted by Callum Devereux-Anand
description: The flagship prestige interview podcast of the Axiom Broadcast Syndicate, distributed on premium neural feed tiers and widely considered required listening for anyone navigating Tier 4-5 professional culture. Host Callum Devereux-Anand — immaculately augmented, perfectly modulated — conducts long-form interviews with corponation executives, Spire civic figures, and the occasional approved artist, in a style that combines surface incisiveness with a structural refusal to ask anything genuinely threatening. The production value is extraordinary; every episode sounds like it was recorded inside a very expensive silence.
medium: premium neural feed / high-fidelity audio stream
cultural_impact: Spire View functions as a social legitimacy mechanism — being invited onto the show signals that a Tier 4 or 5 figure has achieved a certain kind of sanctioned visibility, and the interview questions are so carefully managed that appearing on it is considered safe by even the most image-conscious corponation PR teams.
controversy: A 2216 episode with a HelixCorp VP was interrupted mid-broadcast by a pirated signal injection that replaced ninety seconds of the interview with audio from Ashes in the Signal; the source of the injection was never identified, and the episode was quietly re-released with the ninety seconds replaced by ambient music.
story_hooks: A guest scheduled to appear on Spire View cancels hours before recording; the replacement guest is someone no one in the production team has ever heard of, with impeccable credentials that don't fully check out.

Someone leaks the pre-interview briefing documents for Spire View, revealing the specific topics Devereux-Anand is contractually forbidden to raise with each guest — the list is more revealing than any interview he's ever actually aired.
Callum Devereux-Anand contacts an underground journalist privately, claiming he wants to do a real interview for once, and needs help doing it without being caught.
related_entities: TESSERA CORPONATION Axiom CorpSec Cognition Hardened BCI
